counting_note: R4-001..R4-007 are the remediation items under review. R5-001..R5-003 are new/residual defects found in this round. F1-F10, R2-001..R2-010 and R3-001..R3-008 are regression-checked. FIXED means only the stated offline subparts; never live acceptance.

r4_findings.title: Round/frozen/history constraints work, but Store.save() still permits arbitrary stage/status/approval/P0 transitions

fixed_subparts.a_b_round_monotonic: FIXED: 10/9 -> 0/0, decrease, skip, >10 and wrong event all rejected; legal +1 only via GATE_A/B_ROUND_START
fixed_subparts.frozen_immutable: FIXED: save() rejects any frozen change even with recomputed digest

open_subparts.stage_status: OPEN: save(t,'GATE_0.1_APPROVED') moves WAIT_GATE_01 -> PLANNER/READY with no approval
open_subparts.gate_5_9: OPEN: save currentSha='d'*40, stage=WAIT_GATE_59, then Controller.approve(gate 5.9) closes with no tests/P0
open_subparts.p0_lastB: OPEN: save arbitrary lastB.tests.pass/commit and p0Initial.passed/reports; compliance() returns true
open_subparts.history_forgery: OPEN: arbitrary reviewer/tester/P0 history entries append
open_subparts.round_start: OPEN: GATE_A_ROUND_START advances aRound at WAIT_GATE_01 without a real round

r4_findings.observed: The new #validateTaskTransition covers frozen/rounds/TASK_SPEC/history/baseSha/currentSha but has no stage/status/pendingHuman/lastB/p0/reviewers checks. A direct public save() can therefore jump gates, forge final P0/tester evidence, and approve Gate 5.9. This is exactly the '阶段跃迁或审批绕过' the task required, and the round counter not decreasing does not make Store safe.
r4_findings.minimal_fix: Add a Controller-owned stage/status transition table and validate it in save() (allowed from/to pairs per event type), require approval artifacts/receipts for GATE_0.1/0.2/5.9, require lastB/P0 fields to be produced by typed transitions with matching commit/evidence, and reject history entries not backed by a matching artifact/event.

r4_findings.title: Frozen/pair/type constraints fixed, but init() and first TASK_SPEC are not bound to a trusted Planner/approval root

fixed_subparts.frozen_replacement: FIXED: save() rejects frozen with recomputed digest
fixed_subparts.task_spec_pair: FIXED: save() requires spec+sha both present/absent and matching

open_subparts.init_trust_root: OPEN: Store.init() accepts a forged frozen snapshot with recomputed digest; authorizeRecovery accepts it
open_subparts.init_task_spec: OPEN: Store.init() accepts a pre-set TASK_SPEC pair without TASK_SPEC_CANDIDATE; recovery proceeds
open_subparts.init_incomplete_pair: OPEN: Store.init() stores an incomplete pair; only later assertFrozenIntegrity rejects
open_subparts.planner_binding: OPEN: save(t,'TASK_SPEC_CANDIDATE') works at BLOCKED/WAIT_GATE_01; no stage/role binding
open_subparts.current_sha: OPEN: init() accepts arbitrary currentSha as recovery basis; no Git object/ancestry verification

r4_findings.observed: Controller-side pair check and save-side immutability are real. However, the initial trust root is still caller-supplied: Store.init() does not require WAIT_GATE_01/WAITING_HUMAN, a valid approved frozen config, or absence of taskSpec/currentSha. First TASK_SPEC is guarded only by the caller-chosen event type, not by stage/role. A forged initial snapshot can therefore be recovered as if approved.
r4_findings.minimal_fix: Make init() accept only a minimal creation record (WAIT_GATE_01/WAITING_HUMAN, aRound=bRound=0, no spec/baseSha/currentSha/history) and require the Controller to establish frozen/spec through typed, stage-bound transitions. Bind TASK_SPEC_CANDIDATE to stage PLANNER and a Planner artifact/agent identity.

r4_findings.title: artifact() spans verify, file write/fsync, manifest insert and ledger append in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE; tamper/orphan cases fail closed
r4_findings.observed: Same-connection fsync tamper: rejected with 'task state changed during evidence fsync', DB rolled back, unregistered file causes verify() to fail closed. Second SQLite writer: blocked by BEGIN IMMEDIATE (locked/busy), artifact commits. Registration event failure: DB rollback, file remains orphan, verify() rejects. Pre-existing orphan: artifact rejected before write. Duplicate filename: EEXIST, single manifest row. File system and SQLite are not atomic; the code correctly keeps the orphan for manual reconciliation rather than claiming atomicity.
r4_findings.residual: A crashed registration leaves an orphan requiring manual reconciliation; no automatic cleanup (by design).

r4_findings.title: Multiple independent verdict fenced blocks are conservatively rejected; no example-based winner selection
r4_findings.observed: Two fenced verdicts reject as ambiguous; only a single terminal fenced/bare verdict parses. This is the intended fail-closed contract, not an automatic failure.

r4_findings.title: Local and remote parsers require exactly one terminal verdict; FAIL then PASS never becomes PASS
r4_findings.observed: Local: FAIL/PASS either order rejects; two fences reject; inline example + terminal FAIL returns FAIL; single terminal bare/fenced/indented/CRLF parses; truncated/trailing prose rejects; PASS+BLOCKER rejects; APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS+LOW passes, +HIGH rejects. Remote: final_json returns None for FAIL/PASS and two fences; parse_output returns QUESTION for multi-verdict JSONL and FAIL for a single terminal JSONL; trailing/truncated returns QUESTION; PASS+BLOCKER -> FAIL; APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS LOW/HIGH severity matches local.
r4_findings.residual: Multi-verdict reports require manual reconciliation (intentional conservative behavior).

r4_findings.title: Invisible/deceptive Unicode prefixes are rejected; Chinese and normal filenames remain accepted
r4_findings.observed: U+00AD, U+034F, U+180E, U+3164, U+2800, U+200B, U+200D, U+2060, U+202E, U+FFA0 prefixes before .env are rejected. U+FEFF is rejected as ambiguous whitespace. Fullwidth NFKC .env and leading-space .env are rejected. Normal ASCII foo.env/env/normal.txt/.gitignore and Chinese 中文.txt/中文目录/说明.md/环境.env are accepted. U+2215 is a normal filename, not a path separator.

r4_findings.title: validateStaged scans the full Git index and rejects inherited 120000/160000 and sensitive .env paths
r4_findings.observed: prepare() rejects a base index containing a 120000 symlink, a 160000 gitlink, or a sensitive .env path. commitWorktree() rejects a clean worktree with an inherited symlink. The official Windows test skips real OS symlink creation with EPERM, but the index-level 120000 case is exercised by an independent probe.
r4_findings.residual: Real Windows OS symlink creation is NOT_VERIFIED (EPERM); Git index mode 120000 is verified.

r5_findings.title: Public Store.save() still allows arbitrary stage/status/approval/P0/tester/history forgery
r5_findings.repro: Init at WAIT_GATE_01. (a) save(t,'GATE_0.1_APPROVED') with stage=PLANNER/status=READY -> Gate 0.1 bypass. (b) save(t,'A_COMMIT_FROZEN') with currentSha='d'*40/stage=WAIT_GATE_59 -> Controller.approve({gate:'5.9',digest:sha}) -> CLOSED. (c) save arbitrary lastB.tests.pass/commit and p0Initial.passed/reports -> compliance() returns true. (d) append forged reviewer history. All verify() calls pass.
r5_findings.impact: A caller with Store access can skip Gate 0.1/0.2, fake double review/tester/P0 evidence, and close Gate 5.9 without any real work. This is a gate/approval bypass, not just a missing round check.
r5_findings.minimal_fix: Validate stage/status transitions inside save() against a Controller-owned allowlist per event type; require approval artifacts/receipts for GATE_0.1/0.2/5.9; require lastB/P0 fields to be produced by typed transitions with matching commit/evidence; reject history entries without matching artifact/event.

r5_findings.title: Store.init() accepts a task already at a final/high stage, with forged frozen/taskSpec/currentSha
r5_findings.repro: init({stage:'WAIT_GATE_59',status:'READY',currentSha:'e'*40,aRound:10,bRound:10,frozen:forged}) -> verify() passes -> Controller.approve({gate:'5.9',digest:'e'*40}) -> CLOSED. init with a pre-set TASK_SPEC pair and no Planner event -> authorizeRecovery accepts and moves to PREPARE. init with only taskSpec (no sha) -> verify() passes; only later assertFrozenIntegrity rejects.
r5_findings.impact: The initial trust root is caller-supplied; a new task can start at final gate with forged evidence and be approved. This defeats the intended Gate 0.1/0.2 root of trust.
r5_findings.minimal_fix: Restrict init() to the exact creation record (WAIT_GATE_01/WAITING_HUMAN, aRound=bRound=0, no spec/baseSha/currentSha/history) and require the Controller to establish frozen/spec through typed, stage-bound transitions.

r5_findings.title: baseSha/currentSha are arbitrary strings; no Git object/ancestry check
r5_findings.repro: save(t,'WORKTREE_PREPARED') with baseSha='1'*40; save(t,'A_COMMIT_FROZEN') with currentSha='2'*40; verify() passes. init(currentSha='7'*40) then authorizeRecovery(expectedSha='7'*40) accepts. No Git cat-file/merge-base or frozen baseRef comparison is performed.
r5_findings.impact: A forged commit SHA can become the recovery basis or final commit without existing in the repository or descending from the approved base. This weakens final-commit/P0 binding.
r5_findings.minimal_fix: At preparation/freeze/recovery, verify the SHA exists, is a commit, descends from the frozen baseRef, and matches the worktree's actual HEAD.
